text:
neha: Hey team, quick intro — first day. I can sign in via Okta but I don't see the 'Passkey / Security Key' option and 1Password invite hasn't arrived. Also trying to `git clone git@github.com:redwood/repo.git` fails with permission denied (I think SSH is gated by SSO). Who should I bug for onboarding?

anya-it: Welcome @neha! Sorry about that. Two quick things: 1) We sometimes delay passkey eligibility until device trust completes. Which OS/browser are you on? 2) I'll re-send the 1Password invite and check your Okta app assignments.

neha: macOS Sonoma, using Chrome. Device trust shows 'Enrolled' in Okta dashboard though.

devops-bot: Ticket created: ONB-5479 — "Neha: Missing passkey factor + 1P + SSH access". Assigned to anya-it + rohit. ETA 2h.

anya-it: Got it. I'm seeing your Okta profile — you weren't in the devops-ssh group, so SSH provisioning blocked. I'm adding you now and re-sending 1Password. Also try clearing site data for okta.redwood.ai and then open the enroll flow.

rohit: For the Git SSH gating we use an OIDC/SSO sync that maps Okta groups to GitHub team access. If you're added to devops-ssh it should sync within a minute. If `git clone` still fails, try `ssh -T git@github.com -v` and paste the last two lines here.

neha: Thanks — got the 1Password invite and enrolled TOTP in the app. Re-ran `ssh -T` and it shows: "Permission denied (publickey)." I restarted the agent after adding the key.

rohit: That means your public key hasn't been added to your GitHub profile by the sync. I forced a resync for your Okta->GitHub mapping and added your public key manually from the onboarding doc. Can you try `ssh -T git@github.com` again?

neha: Works now! Also saw Passkey option after reloading Okta and created a passkey in Safari. Everything looks good — Drive access and repos are fine. Thanks for the speedy help :party: 

anya-it: Awesome — welcome aboard @neha. We'll close ONB-5479 once you confirm access to the rest of the repos. If anything else pops up DM me or ping #new-hires.
